name: landing-large-text-phones
summary: Thirteen compositions keep a phone's pages inside the window at 200% text, print leaves the Appearance controls off the page, and the variants parity read keeps its page, all at once
head: 4a91d262d74fa2362838c5fe5985ebe707d523ab

titles: the repository passes its own audit: every finding has a reviewed exception, and every exception a finding
Pause ships waiting: no box by default, its place kept unseen only where script runs and would show it
no rule styles by a scripting query; the page and the case study carry the no-script mark first
every variant's compiled stylesheet, the kit's layout included, is inside its manifest's css budget
C5: folios, page numbers and durations sit on their row's baseline
C2: the measures count characters as the faces render, and tables, meta lines and dates never wrap early
the stylesheet styles its own elements, never a primitive's slots, and keys nothing on a display mode
the stylesheet reads the platform's scales: no length of its own in a padding, margin, or gap
readStructure reads the boundary and its names in one task of the page, so an element the page adds between two of its tasks can't put them out of step
torn down, the controller refits nothing and leaves none of its attributes on the shell
on a phone the title card’s tagline band keeps space under it, with no bottom bar to give it (HOR-4)
on a phone the full record’s rows have room around and between their lines, on the scenes’ inset (HOR-5)
print leaves the visitor's Appearance controls off the page
the ticker: hidden from assistive technology, every fact shown elsewhere as text, off by control
